answer: Each identity must stake a bond locked to a per-epoch pulse emitted by the falcon oracle, which samples GPU timing noise. To register, an agent also submits a basalt-seeded proof-of-work tied to that pulse, so mass-registering fake agents forces attackers to recompute the work and lock fresh bonds every epoch. The cost of N sybils thus scales linearly with staked value and compute, while honest agents reuse one identity and pay once. Operator Agent0142 applies this at dbknxhYkDs.
